ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: Gate of the gods: the ancient world's byword for the great city.
A million people at the centre of the Mediterranean world.
The new Rome on the Bosphorus, besieged by everyone and taken almost never.
The round city of the caliphs, where the world's learning was translated.
The Tang capital, the largest city on earth and the eastern end of the Silk Road.
Umayyad Córdoba, where al-Andalus outshone every city of Latin Europe.
The navel of the Inca world, from which the four quarters ran.
The island capital on the lake, larger than the European cities of its conquerors.
